/*selectMasterWmReExchangeManageList*/
SELECT
-- 발주정보 W.WMRE_NO -- 요청번호 ,W.PO_NO -- 발주번호 ,W.PO_SEQ -- 발주순번 ,D.PO_CREATE_DATE -- 발주일자 ,W.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- 품목코드 ,W.DESCRIPTION -- 품목명 ,W.SPECIFICATION -- 규격 ,W.ITEM_QTY -- 발주수량 ,W.UNIT_MEASURE -- 단위 ,DECODE(C.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'Y',(SELECT C.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY C WHERE C.COM_CODE = W.SELLER),'코리아이플랫폼㈜') AS SELLER_NAME -- 협력사명
-- 고객사 요청정보 ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = W.BUYER AND CODE = W.BUYER_DEPT_CODE ) AS BUYER_DEPT_NAME -- 요청부서 ,W.BUYER_PERSON_NAME -- 요청자 ,W.B_REQ_DATE -- 요청일자 ,W.B_REQ_REMARK -- 요청사유(POP) ,W. WMRE_QTY -- 요청수량 ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'WM01' AND CODE = W.WMRE_TYPE ) AS WMRE_TYPE_NAME -- 요청구분(01반품/02교환 /03주문취소)
-- 운영사 접수정보 ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = W.ADD_USER_ID ) AS ADD_USER_NAME -- 접수자 , M_REC_DATE --접수일자 ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'WM07' AND CODE = W.FLAG ) AS FLAG_NAME -- 진행상태 ,CASE WHEN W.FLAG = '01' THEN '고객사요청' WHEN W.FLAG IN ('02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12' ) THEN 'KEP접수' WHEN W.FLAG = '13' THEN '종결' WHEN W.FLAG = '19' THEN '취소' END NAME_FLAG , W.END_DATE --완료일자 , W.CANCEL_REMARK --취소사유(POP) FROM BNTWMRE W, ICOMPOHD D, ICOMCMPY C
WHERE W.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND W.PO_NO = D.PO_NO(+) AND W.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND C.COM_CODE = W.BUYER AND W.B_REQ_USER_ID = DECODE(( SELECT COUNT(USR.USER_ID) FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID =#{st_user_id} AND USR.PR_MNG_FLAG= 'Y'),1,W.B_REQ_USER_ID, #{st_user_id})
AND W.BUYER_PERSON_NAME LIKE #{st_BUYER_PERSON_NAME}||'%'
AND W.B_REQ_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND D.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND W.B_REQ_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND W.WMRE_NO LIKE #{st_WMRE_NO} || '%'
AND W.PO_NO LIKE #{st_PO_NO} || '%'
AND W.WMRE_TYPE = #{st_WMRE_TYPE}
AND W.flag = '01'
AND W.flag in ( '02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12' )
AND W.flag = '13'
AND W.flag = '19'
ORDER BY W.WMRE_NO DESC

/*getMasterWmReExchangeManageList_v2*/
SELECT A.*, (A.WMRE_QTY * A.UNIT_PRICE) AS ITEM_AMT FROM ( SELECT
-- 발주정보 W.WMRE_NO ,W.BUYER -- 요청번호 ,W.PO_NO -- 발주번호 ,W.PO_SEQ -- 발주순번 ,D.PO_CREATE_DATE -- 발주일자 ,W.BUYER_ITEM_NO -- 품목코드 ,W.DESCRIPTION -- 품목명 ,W.SPECIFICATION -- 규격 ,W.ITEM_QTY -- 발주수량 ,W.UNIT_MEASURE -- 단위 ,DECODE(C.AGENT_OPEN_FLAG,'Y',(SELECT C.COM_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMCMPY C WHERE C.COM_CODE = W.SELLER),'코리아이플랫폼㈜') AS SELLER_NAME -- 협력사명
-- 고객사 요청정보 ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD2 WHERE TYPE = 'C001' AND COMPANY_CODE = W.BUYER AND CODE = W.BUYER_DEPT_CODE ) AS BUYER_DEPT_NAME -- 요청부서 ,W.BUYER_PERSON_NAME -- 요청자 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B_REQ_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS B_REQ_DATE --접수일자 ,W.B_REQ_REMARK -- 요청사유(POP) ,W.WMRE_QTY -- 요청수량 ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'WM01' AND CODE = W.WMRE_TYPE ) AS WMRE_TYPE_NAME -- 요청구분(01반품/02교환 /03주문취소)
-- 운영사 접수정보 ,(SELECT USER_NAME_LOC FROM ICOMLUSR WHERE USER_ID = W.ADD_USER_ID ) AS ADD_USER_NAME -- 접수자 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(M_REC_DATE,'YYYYMMDD'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AS M_REC_DATE --접수일자 ,(SELECT TEXT1 FROM ICOMCOD1 WHERE TYPE = 'WM07' AND CODE = W.FLAG ) AS FLAG_NAME -- 진행상태 ,CASE WHEN W.FLAG = '01' THEN '고객사요청' WHEN W.FLAG IN ('02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12' ) THEN 'KEP접수' WHEN W.FLAG = '13' THEN CASE WHEN W.WMRE_TYPE = '09' THEN DECODE((SELECT DT.STATUS FROM ICOMPODT DT WHERE DT.BUYER = W.BUYER AND DT.PO_NO = W.PO_NO AND DT.PO_SEQ = W.PO_SEQ),'D','종결','진행중') ELSE CASE WHEN F_GET_WMRE_STT(W.BUYER,W.WMRE_NO,W.PO_NO,W.PO_SEQ,0) = 'A' THEN '종결' ELSE '진행중' END END WHEN W.FLAG = '19' THEN '취소' END NAME_FLAG , W.END_DATE --완료일자 , W.CANCEL_REMARK --취소사유(POP) ,(SELECT A.PR_NO FROM ICOMPODT A WHERE A.BUYER = W.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = W.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = W.PO_SEQ AND A.STATUS != 'D') AS PR_NO ,(SELECT A.UNIT_PRICE FROM ICOMPODT A WHERE A.BUYER = W.BUYER AND A.PO_NO = W.PO_NO AND A.PO_SEQ = W.PO_SEQ AND A.STATUS != 'D') AS UNIT_PRICE ,(SELECT A.RECV_FLAG FROM ICOMPRDT A WHERE A.STATUS != 'D' AND (A.BUYER,A.PR_NO,A.PR_SEQ) IN (SELECT B.BUYER,B.PR_NO,B.PR_SEQ FROM ICOMPODT B WHERE B.BUYER = W.BUYER AND B.PO_NO = W.PO_NO AND B.PO_SEQ = W.PO_SEQ AND B.STATUS != 'D')) AS RECV_FLAG ,W.WMRE_FILE ,DECODE(W.WMRE_FILE,NULL,'','다운로드') AS WMRE_FILE_YN FROM BNTWMRE W, ICOMPOHD D, ICOMCMPY C
WHERE W.BUYER = D.BUYER(+) AND W.PO_NO = D.PO_NO(+) AND W.BUYER = #{st_com_code} AND C.COM_CODE = W.BUYER AND W.B_REQ_USER_ID = DECODE(( SELECT COUNT(USR.USER_ID) FROM ICOMLUSR USR WHERE USR.USER_ID =#{st_user_id} AND USR.PR_MNG_FLAG= 'Y'),1,W.B_REQ_USER_ID, #{st_user_id})
AND W.BUYER_PERSON_NAME LIKE '%'||#{st_BUYER_PERSON_NAME}||'%'
AND D.PO_CREATE_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND W.B_REQ_DATE BETWEEN #{st_from_date} AND #{st_to_date}
AND W.WMRE_NO LIKE '%'|| #{st_WMRE_NO} || '%'
AND W.PO_NO LIKE '%'|| #{st_PO_NO} || '%'
AND W.WMRE_TYPE = #{st_WMRE_TYPE}
AND W.flag = '01'
AND W.flag in ( '02','03','04','05','06','07','08','09','10','11','12' )
AND W.flag = '13'
AND W.flag = '19'
ORDER BY W.WMRE_NO DESC )A
mapper.update: INSERT INTO KEPQTDT ( BUYER, QUOTATION_NO, QUOTATION_SEQ, REVISION, AGENT, AGENT_REVISION, STATUS, BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_NAME, ATOS_DATE, ATOS_END_DATE, ATOS_END_TIME, ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, DSS_FLAG, DSS_CHOICE ) ( SELECT #{BUYER}, /* 1 : BUYER */ #{QUOTATION_NO}, /* 2 : QUOTATION_NO */ #{QUOTATION_SEQ}, /* 3 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ #{REVISION}, /* 4 : REVISION */ #{AGENT}, /* 5 : AGENT */ #{AGENT_REVISION}, /* 6 : AGENT_REVISION */ 'C', BUYER_ITEM_NO, DESCRIPTION, SPECIFICATION, UNIT_MEASURE, MAKER_NAME, ORIGIN_CODE, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYYMMDD')AS ATOS_DATE, #{ATOS_END_DATE}, /* 7 : ATOS_END_DATE */ #{ATOS_END_TIME}, /* 8 : ATOS_END_TIME */ ITEM_QTY, IMAGE_KEY, #{DSS_FLAG}, /* 9 : DSS_FLAG if(chk_str[1].equals("A") || chk_str[1].equals("B") || chk_str[1].equals("C")|| chk_str[1].equals("S")) : Y , 기타 : N */ #{DSS_CHOICE} /* 10 : DSS_CHOICE */ FROM KEPRQDT WHERE BUYER=#{BUYER} /* 11 : BUYER */ AND QUOTATION_NO=#{QUOTATION_NO} /* 12 : QUOTATION_NO */ AND QUOTATION_SEQ=#{QUOTATION_SEQ} /* 13 : QUOTATION_SEQ */ AND REVISION=#{REVISION} /* 14 : REVISION */ AND RECV_FLAG <> 'GD' AND STATUS IN ('C','R') )

UPDATE KEPRQDT SET RECV_FLAG = 'GD' , CANCEL_USER_ID = #{USR_ID} /*CANCEL_USER_ID*/ , CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE , CANCEL_REMARK = #{CANCEL_REMARK} /*CANCEL_REMARK*/ WHERE BUYER = #{BUYER} /*BUYER*/ AND QUOTATION_NO = #{QUOTATION_NO} /*QUOTATION_NO*/ AND QUOTATION_SEQ = #{QUOTATION_SEQ} /*QUOTATION_SEQ*/ AND REVISION = #{REVISION} /*REVISION*/ AND STATUS IN ('C','R')
